description_expanded: ABOUT PARADISE LOFT: Welcome to your new luxury 30A coastal escape in Watersound Beach! Paradise Loft is an incredible 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom corner unit condo offering breathtaking panoramic views of the sparkling Gulf waters. Step onto the expansive wrap-around exterior deck and feel the sea breeze as you soak in the picturesque surroundings. Inside this 30A condo rental, you'll find a beautifully designed space with two king ensuites that provide the ultimate relaxation and comfort. The double twin over twin built-in bunk room is a playful retreat for kids or additional guests. As a bonus, this Watersound Beach condo comes fully equipped with four bikes, allowing you to explore the scenic coastal 30A bike trails and six beach towels for your days of sun and sand. Whether unwinding indoors or taking in the stunning views outside, Paradise Loft in Watersound Beach offers the perfect blend of luxury and coastal living. ABOUT THE AREA Located along Highway 30A, Watersound Beach is a picturesque coastal community on the Florida Emerald Coast. This beachside town is known for its white sandy beaches, serene atmosphere, and turquoise waters. It is the perfect tranquil retreat for visitors seeking natural beauty and relaxation. The wide, soft, powdery sand beach in this 30A community is ideal for sunset strolls, building sandcastles, and sunbathing. The Gulf of Mexico waters are suited for a variety of aquatic things to do, including swimming, snorkeling, kayaking, and paddleboarding. Thanks to the refreshing sea breeze and gentle waves, Watersound Beach is a peaceful haven for beachgoers. Watersound Beach is home to more than an incredible shoreline. Conservation areas, coastal cubes, and native vegetation surrounded the town, creating a sense of tranquility and seclusion. The area's architecture is inspired by traditional coastal design, combining charming beach cottages, pastel-colored homes, lush surroundings, and natural surroundings. During your Florida vacation to Watersound Beach, you can enjoy a wide assortment of amenities and activities. Bike along scenic 30A pathways, try your hand at watersports, or explore nearby Florida state parks. Dine at waterfront 30A restaurants and shop at boutique stores. Whether you're looking for things to do outdoors, cultural experiences, or simply a place to unwind and connect with nature, Watersound Beach provides a perfect setting for a memorable Florida beach vacation. BEACH ACCESS: There is private beach access for guests staying at this Watersound Beach rental. PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: - Private beach access - 6 beach towels - 4 complimentary bikes - Newly updated - Beachfront location - Gulf views PARKING: - Free parking for up to 2 vehicles PROPERTY RULES: - Must sign a rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation - Must be 25 years or older to reserve this 30A condo rental - No pets allowed - Guests do not have access to Watersound Beach Club DISCLOSURE: Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction to which we are not notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage. ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests.
